name: CNC Compass Search API
description: Public, read-only. Anonymous calls are rate limited per IP address; an optional API key in `X-Api-Key` (or `Authorization: Bearer`) raises the quota. Every fact in a result is also published as static HTML with JSON-LD at the supplier's page. The same search is exposed as the MCP tool `search_suppliers` at `/mcp`.
